decisions.reason: The low-pressure injection pump is closely tied to the firm's established injection and construction-repair know-how and has its own web page, so the firm can read market feedback and refine it in-house.

The multi-model transfer pump line builds directly on the firm's core conveying and pump engineering, and the variants let management learn which models to adjust within the line rather than withdraw it.

Fire protection flow monitoring draws on less familiar sensing and monitoring knowledge, but it supports the digitalization strategy and benefits from university cooperation, so the firm keeps it while it builds the needed capability.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to the firm's core spraying expertise and is still in its first full year, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it, even though the glass flake two-component system was dropped.
